game.title: Pallanguzhi
game.description: A traditional mancala game played on a wooden board with 14 pits, using small seeds or shells. Popular among women and girls, requiring arithmetic skills and strategic thinking.
equipment: Wooden board with 2 rows of 7 pits
howToPlay: Step 1: Fill each pit with 5 or 6 seeds depending on variation.
Step 2: Players sit facing each other with the board between them.
Step 3: First player picks up all seeds from any pit on their side.
Step 4: Drop one seed in each subsequent pit in counterclockwise direction.
Step 5: If last seed lands in a pit with seeds, pick up those and continue.
Step 6: If last seed lands in an empty pit on your side, capture opponent's opposite pit seeds.
Step 7: Turn ends when last seed lands in empty pit on opponent's side.
Step 8: Game continues until one side has no seeds.
Step 9: Player with most captured seeds wins.
Step 10: Requires counting skills and forward planning.
